title: Kenny Pickett says he's similar to Bryce Young, and the right fit to be his backup

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kenny Pickett says he's similar to Bryce Young, and the right fit to be his backup
sources.description: The Panthers signed quarterback Kenny Pickett last week to back up Bryce Young, and Pickett says he's confident he's the right man for the job.
